summary: Missing information can no longer cause wrong tags or silently closed findings.

fixes.title: Unreadable sources never change a tag
fixes.text: If tagging cannot read something a rule needs, that tag is left as it is and shown as "Unknown" on Tag changes. All other tags are applied as usual.

fixes.title: One broken rule no longer stops a run
fixes.text: When a rule's condition fails, only that rule's tags are left unchanged and named. The rest of the run carries on.

fixes.title: Findings stay open until they are re-checked
fixes.text: The Conditional Access monitor no longer closes a finding it could not check. The finding stays open, marked "awaiting a re-check since" with the date.
